events.headline: NVIDIA board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO (press release about 8:55 am ET, Nov 23). A return had been publicly discussed for a week, and President Trump posted in favour of it on Sunday night, about 11 hours earlier.
events.wrong_way_note: Lower bound from a one-off check covering only the last 21 hours before the news: at least 20 wallets opened shorts of $250k or more from flat.
